is_new_booking_request.description: True only when the member is asking the Club to book a new dining table for themselves (and their party).

party_size.description: Number of people at the table, stated or unambiguous from the people named ("my wife and I" = 2). null when not clear.

requested_dates.description: Every date the member asks for, as YYYY-MM-DD, resolved against the email's sent date in Eastern time. Empty if none is given.

football_weekend.description: True when the request is for a football weekend or game day, or for one of the football Fridays or Saturdays listed.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the decision.
